card.name: Linking words inside fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: The word 'or' after 'indolent' in the HIV immune reconstitution warning, and the comma after 'lithium' in the serotonergic drug list. Also 'and' after 'titled' in a biography.

modes.label: Immune reconstitution wording
modes.description: The word 'or' between 'indolent' and 'residual opportunistic infections' in antiretroviral treatment warnings.
modes.example: may develop an inflammatory response to indolent<< or>> residual opportunistic infections (such as My

modes.label: Serotonergic drug list
modes.description: The comma after 'lithium' in the list of drugs that raise serotonin syndrome risk.
modes.example: (including triptans, tricyclic antidepressants, fentanyl, lithium<<,>> tramadol, tryptophan,

modes.label: Stray biography case
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'titled' in a description of a poem.
modes.example: The work was posthumously titled<< and>> published, prior to which it was generally
